result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends mainly on how many employees you have, your budget, and whether you want the software to handle tax calculations and submissions automatically.

**If you're running a UK-based small business, I would shortlist UK payroll providers rather than US-focused options such as Gusto or OnPay.** You'll want software that supports HMRC Real Time Information (RTI), PAYE, National Insurance, pension auto-enrolment and payslips.

## My top 5 UK payroll software choices

![Sage Payroll](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YilOgYs9ZP1wfwRzJkFxhA_BlX-p_5FLJTmLkaXii1Zq8iZVEoUFx_wBfKoiVfr0ATGd3JsvVUZhJ3dfKZOkGYm_SBzjjNOitZcJhhfq0Ikj-wTCq4Ucb9ThPMpreJ_oVOHjuM4KTvvryzuP8dhTVsVMgw7AVYaGKaHDYZzKiFaOrf3CUXwlR8gKxA64DoWs?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Sage Payroll**

(Best overall)

- Good for small and growing businesses.
- HMRC submissions, payslips and pension support.
- Cloud-based and relatively straightforward.
- Published pricing from around £12/month.
  
  Source: [smallbusiness.co.uk](https://smallbusiness.co.uk/compare-payroll-software-for-uk-small-businesses-2603489/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[velotouch.com](https://velotouch.com/best-payroll-software-for-uk-small-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
  
  [Sage website](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/)

---

![BrightPay Review — Pricing, Comparisons, and FAQs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/sxJjzM-zMoljvbdofSVxv0hc2n6Uhy4wbQoI-ekbYvdu0xYICPVODb96utoDvvyzlqoDFoJM0tCe1PDcjts4d9mO18jCVUAcz8uSYCz66LcGBOZ4zJHJq1yEOQujsPVTylIFBV-0lyobfMgQKjmOTkyQP_pzsfHh1-rqdNp4gQfBPvb7Cxa6acP6JPzSihow?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BrightPay**

(Best dedicated payroll)

- Excellent payroll-focused software.
- Strong pension and HMRC functionality.
- Particularly useful if you have an accountant handling payroll.
- Cloud pricing available on request.
  
  [www.workforce.com](https://www.workforce.com/uk/buyers-guides/best-payroll-software-in-the-uk-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[whichpayroll.com](https://whichpayroll.com/uk/best-payroll-software-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[smallbusiness.co.uk](https://smallbusiness.co.uk/compare-payroll-software-for-uk-small-businesses-2603489/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
  
  [BrightPay website](https://www.brightpay.co.uk/)

---

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Xero Payroll**

- Best if you already use Xero accounting.
- Payroll and bookkeeping work together.
- Employee payslips and HMRC reporting.
- Payroll pricing depends on your Xero plan.
  
  [www.workforce.com](https://www.workforce.com/uk/buyers-guides/best-payroll-software-in-the-uk-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[gosmallbusiness.co.uk](https://gosmallbusiness.co.uk/best-payroll-software-for-small-businesses-in-the-uk/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
  
  [Xero website](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![Quickbooks Logo Png | Quickbooks Logo Vector  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EgpRGTuKXM9JBQhBxDeBmotPOK2V1CAxW6csrlBGPGPM15pztH3eOcpEVWcqc6mS0O1OJQxiy3rYDKVoibK-tXZzwx_-fnc0UCKsZf5bUQtlgBDTtK7dsXwaLO2yAIKNfloGWbyBHt0g2gG5iJtWLQko_1xFOodwaVRw5Zh1K1GZ7uleuWwINKnPwp3V07V7?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. QuickBooks Payroll**

- Good if you already use QuickBooks.
- Integrates payroll with accounting.
- Handles PAYE and statutory payroll calculations.
  
  [www.workforce.com](https://www.workforce.com/uk/buyers-guides/best-payroll-software-in-the-uk-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[gosmallbusiness.co.uk](https://gosmallbusiness.co.uk/best-payroll-software-for-small-businesses-in-the-uk/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
  
  [QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/)

---

![2025 Employment Hero Annual Jobs Report Reveals a Workforce Under Pressure, On the Move, and Rewriting the Rules](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/c72cfBM-wnkCY2sXvC-N2bdeXlozX_a6cLpeiRcNWIdO5skRSiJsO0H69D4TjL37larxeB9RHeRje9o33vXlesf4SGbT2cKN9yyK2lD71zg8gVLQUlVbvzPmQ7XZL_7bga6vNjcRIhuVAHDdb80aC6efbG65m_LmQQnOM37zl4ReRd-YURSotCy3M4QrvYQn?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Employment Hero**

- Worth considering if you want payroll and HR together.
- Employee management and leave administration.
- Has a free payroll option according to its current comparison.
  
  [smallbusiness.co.uk](https://smallbusiness.co.uk/compare-payroll-software-for-uk-small-businesses-2603489/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[velotouch.com](https://velotouch.com/best-payroll-software-for-uk-small-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[whichpayroll.com](https://whichpayroll.com/uk/best-payroll-software-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
  
  [Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/uk/)

## What I would choose

For a typical small UK business\:

- **Sage** for an easy all-round payroll solution.
- **BrightPay** for dedicated payroll functionality.
- **Xero** if your bookkeeping is already there.
- **Employment Hero** if you want payroll and HR together.

One important point: HMRC maintains an official list of recognised payroll software, including free options for businesses with fewer than 10 employees. [See the HMRC list](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/find-payroll-software-that-is-recognised-by-hmrc)\.
